text:
2026 Pokémon World Championships Preview Show
Looking for opinions from some of the brightest minds in the game leading up to the event, or just looking to catch up on the latest strategies? Learn everything there is to know before Worlds by tuning in to the 2026 Worlds Preview Show!

The hosts and expert panelists share years of experience in the world of Pokémon competitive events and are eager to provide their unique perspectives on what to expect for Worlds. During the preview show, you’ll get the full lowdown with in-depth competitor interviews, engaging roundtable discussions, and the top three competitive moments from each game this year.

Here are our hosts and broadcast panelists for the preview show:

Host: Adam Watson (@scarzig)
Host: Rachel “Seltzer” Quirico (@SeltzerPlease)
Pokémon VGC: Charlie Merriman (@chazingdra)
Pokémon TCG: Joe Bernard (@omni_joe)
Pokémon GO: Will Dunphey (@speediestchief2)
Pokémon UNITE: Joshua “ZOINKS” Hiebert (@ZOINKScasts)

We’re also excited to interview the following competitors about their areas of expertise:

Pokémon VGC: Francesco Pio Pero
Pokémon TCG: Liam Halliburton
Pokémon GO: Beelzeboy
Pokémon UNITE: Overlord

Get into the Worlds mood with a closer look at this year's Worlds plush and a chill listening party at the end of the show featuring the 2026 Worlds soundtrack. Don't forget to tune in for a special Pokémon Pokopia announcement taking place for PokémonXP and 2026 Worlds!

Team Rocket’s Ambition Superfan Hackathon
Fellow Team Rocket superfans - this our moment! Join us live as we commence the Pokémon TCG Pocket hackathon in an ambitious attempt to take control of the Pokémon TCG Pocket app.

Your efforts so far have been invaluable, now it is time for the final push. Help us crack the codes and solve the puzzles so we can complete the master plan. All on behalf of our favourite organisation, Team Rocket!
Team Rocket’s Ambition is the latest expansion coming to Pokémon TCG Pocket, launching in-app on August 27th.
